description: This Java class defines a REST controller 'MetricController' that manages endpoints for creating, updating, retrieving, listing, and deleting performance metrics, as well as fetching trend data for metrics associated with employees. It is part of a backend API that handles CRUD operations and data retrieval for performance metrics.

classes.name: MetricController
classes.description: REST controller managing CRUD operations and trend data fetching for performance metrics, exposing endpoints secured for admin and user roles.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new performance metric record based on the provided metric request.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing performance metric identified by its ID with new data.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a specific performance metric by its ID.

methods.name: listByEmployee
methods.description: Lists all metrics associated with a specified employee.

methods.name: trend
methods.description: Fetches trend data over a specified number of days for an employee and metric type, returning timestamps and scores.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a performance metric by its ID.
